meaning:
: speak/tell/command
1) to speak, declare, converse, command, promise, warn, threaten, sing
1a) (Qal) to speak
1b) (Niphal) to speak with one another, talk
1c) (Piel)
1c1) to speak
1c2) to promise
1d) (Pual) to be spoken
1e) (Hithpael) to speak
1f) (Hiphil) to lead away, put to flight

renderings.bsb: and when he described to them

renderings.kjv: That is it that I spake
And he shall be thy spokesman
unto the place of which I have spoken
and for that thou hast spoken
all things which I have spoken
which thou and I have spoken
according to all that he promised
of the which the LORD did say
and that it should be published
And while they were yet talking
in that ye have not spoken
and while they are yet speaking
and that I have not said
Art thou he of whom I have spoken
